ToT Altar as Adult.message: An awakening voice from the Sacred Realm will call those destined to be Sages, who dwell in the five temples. Water Temple... Link's Pocket... Deku Tree... Spirit Temple... Shadow Temple... Forest Temple... The awakened ones will await for the Hero to find Greg. And the evil one's key will be provided once 6 Spiritual Stones and Medallions are retrieved. And the Triforce will be granted once the evil one is defeated. Together with the Hero of Time, the awakened ones will return the light of peace to the world...

ToT Altar as Child.message:
3 Spiritual Stones found in Hyrule... Fire Temple... Jabu-Jabu's Belly... Dodongo's Cavern... Ye who may become a Hero...
The path to the future is open...
